```{r}
#| label: setup
source("_setup.R")
captions <- read_csv(cfg$paper$captions_file, show_col_types = FALSE,
                     col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
dir_fig <- cfg$dir_figures
```

```{r}
#| label: figures
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(captions))) {
  f <- file.path(dir_fig, captions$file[i])
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    cat("\n\n**Figure ", captions$figure[i], ".** File not found: ", captions$file[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
    next
  }
  # path relative to this folder (Quarto reads paths starting with "/" as project paths)
  f <- xfun::relative_path(normalizePath(f), dir = getwd())
  cat("\n\n![**Figure ", captions$figure[i], ".** ", captions$caption[i], "](", f, "){width=6.5in}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n\n```{=openxml}\n<w:p><w:r><w:br w:type=\"page\"/></w:r></w:p>\n```\n\n")
}
```
